name: Catherine
bio: I joined Take The Lead in July 2014 after a successful career in teaching, to pursue my passion for dogs. I've owned and trained dogs for over thirty years. Under the mentorship of respected trainer Kay Attwood I've become a passionate advocate for positive reinforcement training, and I've learned from leading trainers and behaviourists including Sarah Whitehead, Susan Friedman, Steve Mann, Jo-Rosie Haffenden and Nando Brown.
